auditGaps.title: P1: Give all active mocks one account-scoped source of preview state
auditGaps.expected: establish a top-level memory-only store keyed by account ID, with saved identity, saved preferences, pets, favorite IDs, city selection and records. Child screens receive snapshot/context and report mutations by stable IDs. Distinguish display names from identity. Scope drafts to account + form + record; returning to sections must not instantiate unrelated default people.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P1: Complete the first-offer/resume journey with a request ID and a real pending application
auditGaps.expected: carry request ID plus return destination/filter/scroll snapshot; save preferences separately from a working draft. Confirm explicitly creates one mock application for that request. Restore Current, show Applied/pending with withdrawal action and a distinct own-application context; don't expose agreement chat/private instructions until selected. Closing setup returns to initiating list/detail. Cancelling draft edits restores saved values or offers explicit keep/discard behavior.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P1: Connect pet prerequisite, Add Pet and pet details to owned pet records
auditGaps.expected: normal Create checks owned pet collection. No pet → contextual Add Pet, then resume the unsent request draft. Existing pets → select by ID, not arbitrary name. Add appends a pet; Edit changes the chosen ID; details/photo/species/care read that record. Cancel returns without publishing.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P1: Model request publication, selection and agreement stages as object-specific actions
auditGaps.expected: Publish adds one owned open request with submitted pet/date/duration/district and separated private instructions. Responses opens that request's applicants and profiles/reputation. Choose opens an explicit confirmation, then creates one assigned agreement/chat and removes pending actions. Current handles owner and assigned-helper relationships concurrently under one account; helper Start → Finish → awaiting owner confirmation; owner Confirm → History + eligible reviews. Each command updates only its record and handles duplicate/unavailable/conflict fixture outcomes.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P1: Route Chats, notification targets and Walks navigation to their real destinations
auditGaps.expected: use conversation IDs/kinds; inbox rows and events open the selected conversation, preserving messages/draft/scroll/unread state. People-created direct chats and joined-community/meeting/agreement chats appear in common inbox. Route all five Walks destinations through parent navigation. Show missing/deleted/unauthorized targets as unavailable with recovery.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Synchronize favorite places and preserve list state
auditGaps.expected: favorite IDs use shared account store, list and Profile subscribe to same selection. Add/remove changes both screens immediately; close/back retains list query/category/scroll. Named map fallback remains honest and never changes manual city.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Apply city, language and theme consistently across active references
auditGaps.expected: pass canonical city/country/zone/selection and explicit theme/locale to every active screen; preserve manual selection until explicit nearby action. Use clearly labelled empty/unavailable fixtures for unsupported cities rather than Minsk content under another city. Resolve manual-zone ambiguity before time-sensitive save; no silently borrowed zone. Translate authored controls/status/date formatting while retaining names/messages/user content.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Make community invitations open the intended visible community
auditGaps.expected: resolve community ID into visible view, show named detail and explicit Join. For memory-only created groups, either maintain shared session resolver or clearly say invitation cannot resolve outside session; don't create an apparently functional broken link. Removed/private/no-access group shows unavailable state.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Preserve proposal/draft continuity and distinguish cancel from save
auditGaps.expected: per-account/per-record working drafts with explicit dirty-exit decisions. Successful local save commits once and clears working draft; cancellation doesn't mutate saved record. Pending place submissions form author-only records, with reopening/edit/resubmit states as permitted by baseline; public catalog unchanged until moderation preview outcome. No need for real backend.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Make review composition, photo validation and failure feedback observable
auditGaps.expected: after local review Save, show submitted rating/body as a labelled preview while preserving other reviews; required/optional comment follows agreed place-review rule (not walking rule). Define create vs edit behavior before enforcing any new place-review eligibility policy. Show file-size/type/decode errors with retry, keep prior valid photo, and use one re-encoding preview pipeline. Provide mutation saving/error/retry fixtures for reviewed core actions without claiming real upload or aggregate changes.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Make walking reviews eligible per agreement and direction
auditGaps.expected: key review by agreement + reviewer + direction. Only completed owner-confirmed agreement gives owner→assigned-helper and assigned-helper→owner action. Disable duplicate review while preserving the other direction/other records. Show real preview reply text; route preferences pencil to same shared settings. Add public role reputation with no-reviews/unavailable and report states, keeping place ratings separate.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained

auditGaps.title: P2: Make Logout an actual preview transition
auditGaps.expected: move candidate to signed-out entry, clear account-scoped transient private state and pending asynchronous results, and explain it is a preview. Cancel keeps signed-in state. Session revocation still requires native/server verification, outside this mock.
auditGaps.status: Review proposal; active approved presentation retained
